page.title: A builder that thinks like an architect
page.lead: MANI DEVELOPMENT was founded on a simple idea: buildings turn out better when the people who design them and the people who build them sit at the same table.

story.title: Seventeen years, one way of working
paragraphs: We began with private houses and grew project by project into apartment buildings, workplaces and our own developments. The team is larger now, but the principle has not changed: engineers beside designers, a single accountable lead on every site, and no detail left to be solved with a hammer.
story.quote: “Our job is to make the architect’s drawing true, and to make it last.”

mission.title: Build fewer things, build them properly
mission.lead: Our mission is to deliver buildings that their owners are still proud of in thirty years, through honest planning, sound engineering and careful craft.

values.title: Say what it will cost
values.body: Honest numbers early, even when they are not the numbers a client hopes for.

values.title: Draw it before you pour it
values.body: Every junction resolved on paper first. Site is for building, not designing.

values.title: Leave the site better
values.body: Tidy sites, respected neighbours, trees protected, waste sorted.

values.title: Stay after handover
values.body: Twelve months of aftercare and a phone number that is always answered.

standards.title: How we hold ourselves to account

items.title: Inspection hold points
items.body: Reinforcement, waterproofing and facade fixings are inspected and signed before they are covered.

items.title: Material testing
items.body: Concrete, steel and glazing are sampled and tested by independent laboratories on every project.

items.title: Seismic detailing
items.body: Ductile detailing and connection design are reviewed by our engineers on every structure.

items.title: Transparent reporting
items.body: Clients receive weekly progress, cost and risk reports, including problems.

standards.note: Prototype note: the standards described here are illustrative, not claims of certification.

milestones.title: From one house to sixty-four buildings

items.title: Founded in Tbilisi
items.body: David Mchedlishvili starts MANI DEVELOPMENT with six people and a single house in Tskneti.

items.title: First apartment building
items.body: A 24-unit block in Vake, delivered three weeks early.

items.title: Engineering team in-house
items.body: Structural engineers join the company, beginning our design-and-build offer.

items.title: Batumi office
items.body: A second office opens to serve projects along the Black Sea coast.

items.title: Development arm
items.body: MANI DEVELOPMENT begins developing its own residential projects with landowners.

items.title: Saburtalo Exchange
items.body: Our largest commercial building to date reaches completion.

items.title: 64 buildings
items.body: Four projects on site, two in design, and a team of 140.

team.title: The people accountable for your building
